scope: Fix current-account expiry ownership and defer it across sign-in/sign-out,including the proven main-commit/renderer-cache gap. Account requirement review found and fixed a real UI contradiction;broader semantic review remains incomplete.

reproduction.service: Actual JellyfinService+HTTP+MutationCache initially triggered expiry for the newer account from an old held rename401.
reproduction.native: Hold original library401 at actual IPC reply; main commits new account while Connect reply is held; releasing old401 remounts Welcome back for Original listener. Releasing accepted Connect leaves that old screen,although main has New listener.
reproduction.beforeIsControlled: Real native renderer/preload/main/service and HTTP401,with deterministic IPC reply gates. No synthetic auth event or direct UI-state mutation.

implementation.identity: Runtime-only authRevision advances on restore and successful auth commit/disconnect. Library-only commits keep the same authentication identity. No token is exposed or stored format changed.
implementation.bridge: Capture revision when each IPC invocation starts; attach only to unauthorized ApiError. Service error codes,write recovery and request classification remain unchanged. Covers Jellyfin JSON/status requests and media operation replies at one boundary.
implementation.renderer: WaveError retains revision. Global query/mutation expiry only emits for the current cached revision. App rechecks it and defers matching expiry while an authAttempt is pending. Successful account update clears deferred expiry;failure flushes only if the same revision stays current.
implementation.signout: Disconnect participates in authAttempt bookkeeping. Settings/ReadyApp preserve and await the async cache-clear promise before transition settlement. Already-expired retry remains on its current sign-in screen while pending.

decision.challenge: Object identity also changes on library save;classification-before-account-change still leaves reply-delivery gap. Runtime auth generation and IPC-delivery ownership cover both without error-code changes.
decision.Morgan: Use one IPC metadata seam,not nested request wrapper changes. Native reproduction proves pending auth must defer expiry,not merely compare cached account.
decision.reviewFinding: Boris identified analogous disconnect gap;add transition metadata and await connection-cache cleanup.

finalReview.Boris: Accept;no blocker in final diff and focused evidence.
finalReview.Nadia: Accept;no blocker including signout promise/deferral boundary.

native.baseline: 1280x720,100% app zoom;copied distinct native Electron app,production renderer/preload,bundled actual main and service,real local safeStorage,disposable localhost accounts and null shared-key adapter.
native.input: CUA native field edits/clicks only. Playwright lifecycle and passive DOM/main readback. Backend gates hold actual replies,not UI commands or events.

service.method: Actual TypeScript-extracted IPC handler and renderer QueryClient/cache onError,actual WaveError unwrap,JellyfinService and owned HTTP responses. No UI actions or service request/error substitutions.

validation.native: Three final successful processes plus one corrected before reproduction,16 scoped snapshots;zero renderer errors.
validation.bridge: 12 actual-service/HTTP,actual TypeScript-extracted IPC handler,actual renderer QueryClient/cache handler and WaveError cases pass. Stale/current/same/restore/disconnect/library-only/read/non401/interrupted-write covered.
validation.privacy: authRevision is a nonsecret runtime integer;exportSession assertions exclude it. No credential or token output included.
validation.cleanup: All owned observers terminal exit0;catalog servers stopped130. Per-case HTTP servers close in finally.

requirements.actor: Listener changing or recovering an account
requirements.trigger: A Jellyfin expiry reply overlaps sign-in,sign-out,reconnect or a library-only save
requirements.outcome: Only current authentication may expire the UI. Pending account changes retain their page and completion;successful change discards old expiry;failed change applies genuine current expiry after settlement.

Stale expiry after another/same account commits

remaining: Broader account/session lifecycle and listener acceptance remain in their existing scopes.
